title: Continuity Balanced
summary: Cut every path to the finance ledger at or above the 0.20 high-risk threshold, with the least business disruption. Paths below the threshold may stay open only while, together, they reach the ledger in at most 600 of 6,000 simulated rollouts (10 %). The remaining routes are shown; the result is never described as zero risk.

title: Critical Asset Zero Tolerance
summary: No enumerated path to the finance ledger may stay open, whatever its simulated risk. SafeCut may add reversible actions; business impact is still measured against the same limits. It proves only what the modelled graph and evidence establish, not absolute security.
